model_annotation: This pie chart displays the distribution of different categories related to approximate number generation, disjunctive and conjunctive reasoning, and existential quantifiers. The chart contains seven slices, representing the categories “Disjunctive & Conjunctive,” “Approximate Quantities,” “Comparative Relationships,” “Universal Quantifiers,” “Negation,” “Limiter,” and “Existential Quantifiers.” The slice labeled “Disjunctive & Conjunctive” is light blue and occupies approximately 50.49% of the chart, followed by “Approximate Quantities” in green at approximately 45.03%. “Comparative Relationships” is light teal and represents roughly 36.26%, while “Universal Quantifiers” is pink at 29.07%. “Negation” is light orange and occupies 27.91%, equal to the proportion of “Limiter” which is light purple and also makes up approximately 27.91%. Finally, “Existential Quantifiers” is represented by a peach-colored slice, accounting for about 15.12% of the chart. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and a legend is included to identify each category with its corresponding color; the segments appear to be ordered clockwise, decreasing in size from the "Disjunctive & Conjunctive” slice.
